text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the RFC — proposing a runtime split: fastpath handles dashboard queries with gate-layer RBAC (coarse checks, capability tokens), slowpath keeps full projection-level RBAC + deep joins. Tradeoffs: lower latency for common reads vs duplication of auth logic and cache invalidation. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on lower latency but worried about correctness surface. If fastpath uses coarse auth we need a deterministic escape hatch for edge cases. Also cache invalidation on role changes is scary.

kevin: can we use a short-lived capability token issued after a full auth check? i.e. first slowpath call issues token, subsequent fastpath reads accept token for Xs. avoids repeated deep checks.

alex: exactly what I sketched. capability tokens TTL=30s, bound to tenant+route+principal. fallback to slowpath on token miss/invalid.

tao: rollout plan: feature-flag per-tenant, start with read-only dashboards + small tenant subset. need metrics to catch stale-perm regressions (false positives: serving data user shouldn't see).

maria: agree. We should also sample 1% of fastpath responses and re-run full projection auth in background to diff results (safety net). If mismatches > threshold -> auto-disable for tenant.

kevin: perf note: allow fastpath to answer from prefetched projections + KV cache. batching + de-dup across widgets. But be careful: stale cache + role changes = leakage. TTLs + explicit invalidation events from IAM.

alex: sketch of routing policy config (pseudo):
```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"name":"fastpath-dashboard","check":"capability_token","max_latency_ms":80},
    {"name":"slowpath-projection","check":"projection_rbac","max_latency_ms":500}
  ]
}
```

maria: +comment: add "auth_version" to token binding so we revoke on IAM schema bump. Also audit logs for every fastpath token validation.

kevin: alarms we should track: token-issuance-rate, fastpath-mismatch-rate (from sampled recheck), fastpath-p99 latency, slowpath-fallback-rate. rolling windows and pager if mismatch>0.1% over 10m.

tao: one more operational concern: canary to 1% of requests globally might hide tenant-level issues. do per-tenant canary (random 5 tenants) + per-route canary.

alex: agreed. Also plan for a gradual degrading policy: if capacity low -> route to cheaper model variant OR serve cached view with "stale=true" flag. UX needs to handle stale.

maria: UX note: include an unobtrusive toast + telemetry so product knows how often stale shows up.

ci-bot: Integration tests: dashboard auth sampling harness added. tests/eng/platform/dashboard_fastpath_sampling_test.py passed.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by alex (feature/fastpath-authz) — staging rollout started for tenants: alpha-3, sandbox-7.

kevin: checklist for next week: 1) sampling infra + diff job, 2) capability token implementation + KMS binding, 3) invalidation event plumbing from IAM, 4) dashboards telemetry, 5) canary runner per-tenant.

alex: thanks. I'll open follow-up PRs and link RFC -> implement checklist. If anyone wants to pair on the sampling job ping me. :thumbsup:
